necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with persistent palpitations and symptomatic bradycardia consistent with a history of sick sinus syndrome, corresponding to diagnosis codes I49.5 and R00.2. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the service despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197 for missing prior authorization.
